description: This file defines a configuration subclass for handling OpenAI's O-series models within the litellm framework, including methods for model parameter support and message transformation specific to these models.

classes.name: OpenAIOSeriesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI O-series models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with specialized methods for parameter support, message translation, and model identification.

methods.description: Returns configuration settings from the superclass.

methods.description: Processes messages to support 'developer' role for O-series models.

methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model, including O-series specific parameters and adjustments based on provider capabilities.

methods.name: map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters, handling special cases like 'temperature' and 'max_tokens'.

methods.name: bool is_model_o_series_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string corresponds to an O-series model (o1, o3, o4).
